column3: Settled at the back early - made progress from 4f out to be third with over 2f left - hit the front a furlong out - opened up inside the final 110 yards to score comfortably
Sluggish start - settled towards back and pulling hard early on - closed on front group two furlongs out - kept going strongly to claim runner-up spot late
Settled just behind pace early holding a tight hold - went to front turning into final 2f - pressed for effort when overtaken with a furlong left - eased back through the field late to finish third
Settled in the pack - driven up 3f from home to press the front group 2f out - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - lost ground into the last three furlongs and pushed along with two to go - stayed on at the same rate to finish fifth
Handy early behind the front group - urged forward soon after halfway - lost ground under pressure from 2f out and dropped away to finish sixth
Went straight to front and pulled hard early - pushed along when overtaken 2f out - lost place in a hurry approaching the last furlong to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early - began to labour before the final furlong and slipped to the back - unable to stay in contention through to the line - well held in 8th
Handy in the pack early - closed on the front group after the second-last - hit the front before jumping the final fence untidily - drew away up the run-in to score comfortably

Settled handy in the pack - moved closer to front group before 5th - went in front 7th - slipped back to second 8th - regained command 10th - challenged approaching two out - overtaken before last - unable to match front two on run-in - fought back to snatch second right on the line

Settled midway through the pack - improved into contention by the 6th - up into second next - moved to front at the 8th - overtaken 10th - pressed the front-runner around the home turn - battled for second after the last but edged out close home
Held up towards the back - stumbled and lost rider 3rd
Settled in the pack early - blundered after 9th and lost rider
Set the pace early - lost front spot at the 7th and slipped through the pack - beaten off the pace and eased out of it before 2 out
Settled towards the back - dropped away from the pack after the 9th - eased and pulled up before the 11th
Held up towards the back - lost touch from three out - dropped away with no chance and eased out of contention before the final fence

Held a handy position early moving smoothly - up behind the front group after the second last - edged across before the final fence - stumbled at the last - quickly balanced up - drew away easily on the run-in to win

Went straight to the front and dictated a fast gallop - required urging after the 4th - overtaken 3 out - fought back to draw alongside the front-runner nearing the last - held on to that spot through the run-in - stayed on well but edged out into second
Settled towards the back - pushed into contention approaching the final two flights and finished strongly after the last - moved into third on the run to the line
Settled in second early - hit the front three out - driven up approaching two out - overtaken before the last and faded on the run-in
Settled in mid-division - lost place from 3 out and came under pressure approaching 2 out - responded to keep on after the last for a distant fifth
Settled in the pack early - lost momentum after 2 out and dropped away after the last - finished sixth well beaten
Settled at back of field - lost touch after two out - dropped away before the last - finished seventh
Held up in the pack - blundered 5th and lost touch - error again 3 out then dropped away to finish last of eight
Asked for effort early - settled second before advancing on the front-runner approaching the 9th - took over shortly after 3 out - opened a decisive advantage before 2 out to score
Settled at back early - improved into contention 5th - pushed along after two out - moved up into second before the last - lost ground after the last and faded to finish second

Set the pace from the off - opened a six length advantage by the third - stretched the advantage but hit an untidy jump at the 8th - margin shrank markedly by the 9th - blundered three out - quickly overhauled by the eventual winner - faltered and was pulled up before the last
Settled third early - veered right and serious blunder 2nd fence - lost ground to the rear by the 5th - reminders after the 6th - well behind and jumped poorly again 7th before pulled up
Settled towards the back early - moved into contention approaching two out - hit the front before the last - drew away up the run-in for a comfortable win
Held up in last place - made progress from 7th - moved into second 2f out - pressed the winner after the final flight - driven out on the run-in for second
Held up towards back of the field - progress from two out to move into third by the last - unable to match front two in closing stages
Handy up front - driven and eased back through the pack from the 7th - dropped away before the final flight
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost front spot approaching the bend before the last - dropped away fast on the run to the line - finished 5th
Sat close to the front early - lost touch beyond four out and dropped well behind - eased and pulled up before the final fence
Settled in the pack early - lost touch and toiling four out then labored over the second-last - eased and pulled up before the final obstacle
Settled in second early - driven up before three out then dropped away rapidly after two out - well beaten and eased before the final fence
Set the pace from the off - clear in front throughout - ran out an easy winner
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort over 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong though never able to trouble the winner - finished second beaten 2.5 lengths
Uneven early rhythm holding a forward spot - urged into effort with 3f remaining - driven with 2f left - stayed on at one tempo through the closing stages to finish third
Missed the break and dropped to the back - urged forward from 3f out - progress made after moving left over 1f out - plugged on at one speed to finish 4th
Driven to make progress 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong - kept going without ever getting competitive - finished fifth
Fought for control early - settled towards the back - improved into contention 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out but found nothing more - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack early on - roused to press forward three furlongs out - kept up to pressure two out - dropped away a furlong later - allowed to drop away inside final furlong and finished 7th
Sat just behind the front group - urged into 4th with 2f left - found extra to hit the front a furlong out and kept finding more to the line
Sat just behind pace - moving smoothly into second spot 2f out - pressed for advantage and hit the front 1 1/2f out before being reeled in - held safe late to finish second

Settled towards the back - pulled hard early - badly baulked at halfway - roused in 10th with 2f to run - finished with purpose through the final furlong - third at the line and doing best work at the finish
Sat handy behind the pace - pushed along in 5th two out then up to 3rd approaching the final furlong - held on for 4th without finding more
Settled in the pack midfield - pushed along in 8th two out then 7th approaching final furlong - stayed on late for 5th
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for effort in 6th with 2f left - unable to close the gap - held on for 6th
Held up at back - checked around halfway - pushed along in 12th two out - stayed on late to finish seventh beaten six and a half lengths
Held up towards the back - checked in running at halfway - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on same speed late
Settled just behind pace-setter early - went on 2f out - pressed and lost front spot 1 1/2f out - slipped back to 4th before fading out of contention
Missed the break badly - settled at back of field - checked in running at halfway - pushed along with two furlongs left but unable to make headway - beaten well into 10th
Sent clear early - pressed for effort with pace easing 2f out - dropped away to finish 11th
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along in 7th with 2f to run - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Settled towards the back of the pack - checked in running at halfway - unable to build any momentum after and soon dropped away
Held up towards the back - came down at halfway
Settled in the pack - came down at halfway

Stood up and hesitant to begin - settled towards the back early - made ground through the middle from halfway - urged into contention approaching final furlong - hit front close home and stayed on to win
Up with the pace - nudged forward 2f out - briefly short of room inside the final furlong - burst through into second late on - went down by a head
Settled second early - hit front over 2f out - driven out a furlong later then overtaken inside final furlong - dropped away close home
Held up towards the back - last of all approaching halfway - shifted through and finished well to close inside final furlong
Set the pace early - lost front spot 2f out then lacked the pace to respond - dropped away inside final 110yds finishing 5th
Handy with the pace - kept short of room from inside the final furlong - dropped away close home - finished sixth beaten 3¾ lengths
Sat behind pace early - driven into command over 2f out - urged clear inside final furlong - held on for the win
Tracked the front group early - driven approaching 2f out and again inside the final furlong - kept on into second but unable to reach the winner
Settled towards the back - made progress from 3f out - pressed for effort with 2f to run - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong to finish third
Sat behind the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven out a furlong out - stayed on inside the final furlong without threatening
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept trying inside final furlong but no threat to leaders
Hesitant start - settled near the back - pressed for effort 2f out but found little - held off throughout finish sixth beaten 10 lengths
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost the front spot approaching 2f out - dropped away meekly before the final furlong to finish seventh
Set the pace from the start - driven on approaching 2f out then edged in front close home - fought back gamely in the last furlong to prevail on the line
Sat second early - asked for effort with 2f to run - edged in front a furlong out - battled to the line - caught right on the post to finish second
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along in 4th with 2f left before edging into 3rd inside the final 1 1/2f - stayed on at an even effort to finish third
Held up towards the back - improved into 6th and driven with two furlongs left - stayed on same speed to finish 4th
Settled behind front group early - still in touch until 2f out in 5th when pressed for effort - couldn't quicken final furlong - finished well held in 5th
Handy early behind the front group - lost ground after a heavy blunder at halfway then slipped to 8th under pressure - stayed on at one speed to finish sixth
Settled around midfield - pushed along in 9th with 2f left before being hampered a furlong and a half out - unable to threaten the leaders and finished well held in 7th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along in 7th approaching final 2f - unable to close the gap - finished well held in 8th
slow to break - held up towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway 2f out - hampered 1½f out and held on final effort finished 9th
Poor start - held up at the rear throughout - no impression made - finished well beaten in 10th
Held up at the back - checked with a furlong and a half left - unable to close from there - well held at the finish
Struggled from the outset - held towards the rear throughout - no real involvement in the finish
Held a midfield position early - unable to make headway from 3f out - dropped away late to finish 13th
Held up at rear from the start - checked by interference with a furlong and a half left - no impact on the finish - well beaten in 14th
Sat close to the front group early - urged into 3rd approaching 2f out - lost footing and slipped back to 4th with a furlong and a half left
Settled off the pace in the pack - urged forward approaching 2f out - shifted across and gained ground inside the final furlong - stayed on well to score close home
Handy in the pack early - hit the front a furlong out and pushed along - couldn't find more close home and just caught right on the line
Handy early - moved through to hit the front over 2f out but only for a moment - stayed on terms into the last stretch - unable to find more and eased back to finish third
Dwelt at the start - dropped to the back of the field - niggled into contention over 1f out - kept on strongly up the far rail to claim fourth
Went straight to the front early - drifted left approaching the home turn - lost the advantage with 2f left - driven out but faded inside the final 110yds to finish fifth
Held up in the pack - made progress on the front group 3f out - pushed along inside the final furlong then dropped away close home
Held a central position early - made progress into contention two out but had to check for space on the outside approaching the last furlong - lost momentum late to finish seventh
Settled in the pack early - slipped towards the back and given encouragement with two furlongs left - lost ground inside the closing furlong to finish eighth
Settled into second early - drifted left and stayed wide - lost place over 2f out - faded through final furlong to finish ninth
Held up towards the back - lost touch with the pace two furlongs out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Settled just behind pacesetter early - pushed along with two furlongs left - edged closer and hit front approaching final furlong - powered away to win going away
Set the early gallop - driven along 2f out - challenged into final furlong - overtaken and held on gamely to the line for second
Settled handy from the break - pushed along with 2f remaining - stayed on in the closing stages - finished third without threatening the front
Settled in the pack - pushed along and made progress with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside the last - finished 4th
Held up at back - moved right and closed ground over 2f out then pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on modestly at the finish
Stood up at the break - settled in the pack - driven approaching 2f out - asked for effort inside final furlong but found little - lost ground in the closing stages to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - improved but drifted off a true line 2f out - pushed along inside the final furlong and always held finishing seventh
Held up towards the back - driven along approaching 2f out - allowed to drop away steadily inside final furlong - finished last of the runners
Settled third early - moved wide to reach the front group 4f out - hit the front past 2f out - pulled clear approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Drifted right early to sit second - narrowed gap on pace-setter 6f out - driven approaching final 2f and stayed on but unable to reel in winner late to finish 2nd beaten 3¼ lengths
Settled towards the back early - made progress from 3f out and pushed along with 2f left - moved into third inside the closing stages - lost momentum when squeezed for room close home

held up towards the back - travelling with enthusiasm early on - urged forward with three furlongs left - driven out approaching the final two - kept responding to close inside the last 110 yards but denied third close to the line
drifted right early settling in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left then lost ground a furlong out - lost place inside the final furlong to finish fifth
settled towards the back early - lost touch with the pace over 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually finished sixth

Drifted right early to take command - opened a big advantage on a fast gallop before the margin shrank with 6f left - overtaken 2f out - dropped away rapidly inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Held a forward position early - urged on 3f out and lost pace 2f out - dropped away nearing the final furlong
Held up at the back - lost touch from over 2f out - dropped away final furlong - finished ninth well beaten
took a strong hold in the pack - found room and made progress 2f out - pushed along to close between horses inside the final furlong - hit the front close home - won comfortably
settled in the pack early - moved through and gained ground 2f out - eased over to the right and pushed along inside the final furlong - stayed on well to close but edged out into second
tracked the pace - pushed along 2f out - hit the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on inside it before being overtaken close to home - edged out of second near the line to finish third
settled towards the back showing eagerness early - driven into contention 2f out - asked for effort inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth beaten 3 lengths
Held eagerly early - settled mid-pack - moved through 2f out then held effort inside final furlong to finish 5th
Raced in a handy spot wide - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at one gait inside final furlong - finished sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Poor start and settled at the back - pushed along and drifted wide entering the straight over a furlong out - unable to threaten finished 7th beaten 6.5 lengths
Set the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - lost the advantage inside the final furlong - faded quickly and well held at the line
Towards the back - nudged and moved right approaching 2f out - swung wide into the straight - never able to go the pace and faded to finish 9th
settled mid-pack early - roused with two out and closed on the front group - drove into contention a furlong out and edged ahead close home - kept up the effort to the line
Settled at the back early - shifted wide and closed strongly over a furlong out to move into second inside the final 110 yards - stayed on well but denied by a half-length at the line
Settled just behind the front-runner early - challenged approaching final furlong - edged back to third near the line but stayed on well
Settled towards the back but not far off the pace - moved through the middle of the track to improve position two out - squeezed for space entering the last furlong - stayed on well to finish fourth
went straight to the front - driven when confronted for the advantage 2f out - eased out of contention approaching the last furlong and a half - dropped a place close home to finish fifth
well placed with the front group - boxed in for space with 2f left then drifted right approaching the final furlong - lost momentum close home to finish sixth
settled in the back half of the field - moved up to challenge the front group approaching halfway - struggled for pace in the final 2f and dropped away inside the last 110yds to finish 7th
Held a forward spot wide of rivals - asked for effort with 2f left - drifted right and lost momentum entering the last furlong - dropped away well behind at the line
Set the pace from the break - clear in front throughout with no serious pressure - held the advantage to the line easily
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort a furlong out and stayed on at one level through the closing stages - always second best behind a clear-cut winner
held up towards the back - progress blocked past halfway - pushed along with 2f left - closed on the inside in the closing stages to finish third
mid-pack early - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - stayed on at one effort inside final furlong but edged out of third close home
Handy early - pushed along with over two furlongs left but found nothing - dropped away inside final furlong to finish fifth
Poor break costing several lengths - stayed towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and unable to quicken - finished well held in 6th
Settled in third early - improved into second by halfway - moved smoothly to the front approaching the final furlong - edged away inside the closing yards - won comfortably
Handy with the front group early - moved into runner-up spot inside final furlong - stayed on to the line without reeling in the winner
held a middle position early - improved position and pressed the front runners approaching the last furlong - stayed on to finish third
Held up at the back - lost touch approaching halfway - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 4th
settled in second early - slipped to third by halfway - driven approaching the closing stages - lost touch inside the last furlong and faded close home finishing fifth
Went straight to front - pushed along when overtaken inside final furlong - dropped away rapidly close home - finished sixth
Dwelt at the start - dropped to the back of the field - shifted towards the middle to challenge from 2f out - found nil and dropped right out to finish a well-beaten 7th
settled midway - pushed along and made progress 2f out - kept on strongly inside final furlong - hit the front close home to score comfortably
Slow to break - travelled strongly in touch with the pace - short of space 2f out - shifted right and pressed on inside final furlong - finished second having stayed on
tracked the pace early - shaken up to go in front approaching 2f out - driven with a furlong left - battled on inside the final furlong - overtaken close home to finish third
mid-pack early - driven into contention approaching final 2f and well placed with 1f left - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth
Sent to the front early - pressed for effort and lost command inside final 2f - held rate through closing stages without finding more late off fifth
settled in the pack - made progress 2f out - eased across to the rail approaching final furlong under pressure - kept on to finish sixth beaten under five lengths
pulled hard towards the back - nudged along over 2f out - failed to find any pick-up - faded to finish 7th
Settled towards the back - moved through field 2f out - pushed along a furlong out but failed to build on it - well held in 8th
settled near the back - pushed along with 2f remaining - unable to land a blow through to the line - finished ninth
Set out in front from the off - held the advantage throughout - pulled clear in the closing stages to score comfortably
Slow into stride - settled towards the rail in the pack - made progress under a furlong out - pressed the winner inside the last - stayed on to finish second
Held a forward position early - closed on the pace turning into the last furlong - lost momentum inside the final 110yds to finish third
Held handy position early - pressing pace-setters passing the furlong marker but drifted right approaching the final furlong and could not get on terms with the front three close to home

Settled into second early - urged forward with over two furlongs left - lost place approaching final furlong and looked unfurnished under pressure - eased back through the closing stages to finish fifth
mid-pack early - lost ground with a furlong left - dropped away quickly to finish sixth
Held up at the back - nudged into contention entering the last furlong - dropped away in the closing stages - finished seventh
Held a forward position early - lost ground with a furlong to run - dropped away close home to finish eighth
settled towards back of field - failed to threaten leaders - finished 9th
Held up at the back - no impression made - well held throughout
